submission.justification: F2 at 5 mm gives the best simulated resolution at 100 GeV (3.263, versus 3.781 for F1 at 4 mm and 4.98 for F3 at 4 mm). Each material has an interior optimum in thickness. CAVEAT: no residual dose data was obtained for any material, so the hard 20 uSv/h limit is unverified for F2 and for the alternatives. This recommendation is provisional and must not be treated as compliant until the dose at 1 m after one week of cooldown is checked. If F2 fails that check, the next candidate is F1 at 4 mm.

requirements.requirement: Best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV
requirements.evidence: F2 at 5 mm has the best resolution of the scanned options: 3.263, versus F1 3.781 at 4 mm and F3 4.98 at 4 mm. The optimum is interior to the scanned range for all three materials.

requirements.requirement: Residual dose rate at 1 m after 1 week <= 20 uSv/h (hard)
requirements.evidence: dose_data_available_F2=0, dose_pass_confirmed_F2=0 and compliant_material_found=0. No dose data exists for any material, so compliance is not verified.

requirements.requirement: Absorber is one of the three listed materials
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F2 is one of the candidates F1, F2 and F3.
5 mm is within the 2-10 mm range.
